_comment: Prices in USD per 1M tokens. These are the source of truth for cost accounting against the mock providers. If you add a real provider, append its models here with current prices from the provider's pricing page. openrouter-small = openai/gpt-4.1-nano and openrouter-large = openai/gpt-4.1-mini at OpenRouter's list prices (2026-10-01); they are priced here but only routable when an OpenRouter key is set (data/gateway_extras.json).
